sentences.zh: 拍的时候忍住不笑有多难？

sentences.zh: 我告诉你，这是剧本写的，但这是备选的采访镜头。

sentences.en: This is not the one that appeared in our shooting draft.
sentences.zh: 这不是我们拍摄初稿中出现的那一个。

sentences.en: So, I wasn't there when they shot it, but I have to imagine it was very difficult to get through.
sentences.zh: 所以，他们拍摄时我不在场，但我能想象这一定很难拍完。

sentences.en: Well, it's Michael's turn to give blood, guys.
sentences.zh: 好了，轮到迈克尔献血了，伙计们。

I don't get faint or anything, but I don't like to watch it.
sentences.zh: 我倒不会晕倒什么的，但我确实不喜欢看。

sentences.en: I don't like to see the needle go in my arm.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢看针扎进我胳膊里。

sentences.zh: 我不喜欢看血袋装满，但我对血也不会感到头晕或不适。

sentences.en: If someone's bleeding, it doesn't make me faint.
sentences.zh: 如果有人流血，我不会晕倒。

sentences.en: Michael, on the other hand, is very nervous.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，迈克尔非常紧张。

sentences.en: But luckily, there's a lovely young woman also giving blood, and they start joking around.
sentences.zh: 但幸运的是，还有一位可爱的年轻女士也在献血，他们开始开起玩笑来。

sentences.en: We asked Katie about this scene.
sentences.zh: 我们问了凯蒂关于这场戏的事。

sentences.en: I wanted to know, did she do any research into the process of giving blood and all of that?
sentences.zh: 我想知道，她有没有对献血的过程之类的做过研究？

sentences.en: And here's what she had to say.
I didn't do any research for this role, but I didn't need to because my character was just nervous and pleasant, and I didn't have to dig super deep to access those emotions.
sentences.zh: 我没有为这个角色做任何研究，因为没必要，我的角色只是表现得紧张又和善，我不需要深入挖掘就能体会到那种情绪。

sentences.en: But the funny, I do have a very funny anecdote about being nervous, or my character being nervous, is that my first line was me just laughing nervously and saying, I'm so sorry,
sentences.zh: 但有趣的是，关于紧张，或者说我的角色表现出的紧张，我有一个非常有趣的轶事，我的第一句台词就是紧张地笑着说，我很抱歉，

sentences.en: And Steve kept cutting, and he would be like, oh, no, it's okay, we'll go again, we'll go again.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫一直喊停，他会说，噢，不，没关系，我们再来一次，再来一次。

sentences.en: And finally, I was just like, I think it's my line.
sentences.zh: 最后，我只好说，我觉得那就是我的台词。

sentences.en: I think that's what I'm supposed to say.
sentences.zh: 我想我本来就该那么说。

sentences.en: But that has always made me laugh.
sentences.zh: 但这件事一直让我觉得很好笑。

sentences.en: And of course, yes, I was thrilled to work with Steve.
sentences.zh: 当然，能和史蒂夫合作我非常激动。

sentences.en: To get that, to get the show was its own triumph, but then to have my scene be with him was just like, I was over the moon.
sentences.zh: 能得到这个角色本身就是一种胜利，但能和他演对手戏，我简直高兴坏了。

sentences.en: I love that story about Steve, because he was such a caretaker like that.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢那个关于史蒂夫的故事，因为他就是那样一个会照顾人的人。

sentences.en: He would want our guest actors to feel really comfortable, and he'd be like, oh, no, it's okay, we'll start again.
sentences.zh: 他希望客串演员能感到真正舒适，他会说，噢，不，没关系，我们重新开始。
我们等你准备好了再说。

sentences.en: I was like, no, it's actually my line.
sentences.zh: 我当时就想，不，那其实是我的台词。

sentences.en: I would also be relieved if the first time I ever had to be in a scene with Steve, I got to just laugh nervously and say I was nervous.
sentences.zh: 如果我第一次和史蒂夫演对手戏，我也能紧张地笑笑说我很紧张，我也会感到如释重负。

sentences.en: Because it would be so truthful.
There's a third person in this scene.
sentences.zh: 这场戏里还有第三个人。

sentences.en: I wondered if she was a real bloodmobile nurse, since that was a real bloodmobile.
sentences.zh: 我很好奇她是不是真正的献血车护士，因为那确实是一辆真正的献血车。

sentences.en: Yeah, and she seemed kind of no-nonsense, like very comfortable there.
sentences.zh: 是啊，她看起来很干练，在那儿待得很自在。

sentences.en: Well, she was, in fact, an actress.
sentences.zh: 嗯，事实上，她是一位演员。

sentences.en: She has not been on Monk.
But she was on several episodes of The Young and the Restless, as well as many movies and TV shows.
sentences.zh: 但她出演过几集《年轻和骚动不安的一族》，以及许多电影和电视剧。

sentences.en: Well, Michael's going to make the mistake of looking at his blood bag.
sentences.zh: 嗯，迈克尔犯了个错误，他盯着自己的血袋看。

sentences.en: And he says to her, tell me stories.
sentences.zh: 他对她说，给我讲讲故事。

sentences.en: And he's, I think, so happy.
sentences.zh: 我想他当时一定很高兴。

sentences.en: And then he shares that he didn't eat for three days because he was so nervous about giving blood.
sentences.zh: 然后他分享说，因为太紧张不敢献血，他已经三天没吃东西了。
我们收到一个粉丝提问。

sentences.en: Many, many people wanted to know, how do we do these scenes of people giving blood?
sentences.zh: 很多人都想知道，我们是怎么拍那些献血场景的？

sentences.en: Some people wanted to know, did they actually give blood?
sentences.zh: 有些人想知道，他们是真的献血了吗？

sentences.en: Well, yes, the next day, but not while we were filming.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是的，那是第二天，但不是在拍摄的时候。

sentences.en: The next day with trained professionals and not actors pretending to take blood.
sentences.zh: 第二天是在专业人员的指导下，而不是让演员假装抽血。

sentences.en: I found out how they make fakie blood.
sentences.zh: 我打听到了他们是怎么制作假血的。

sentences.en: It's a combination of water, food coloring, and you're not going to believe it.
sentences.zh: 它是用水、食用色素混合而成的，你绝对想不到还有什么。

sentences.en: I want to try to guess.
I thought you could eat it.
I was going to say like Jell-O.
sentences.zh: 我本来想说是像果冻那样的东西。

sentences.en: That thickens it a little, I guess.
sentences.zh: 我想那能让它稍微浓稠一点。

sentences.en: So our blood was all made by our special effects team led by Ron Nary.
sentences.zh: 所以我们的血都是由Ron Nary领导的特效团队制作的。

就像灰姑娘的水晶鞋一样。

sentences.en: I asked her, anything stick out to you?
sentences.zh: 我问她，有什么特别让你印象深刻的事吗？

sentences.en: And Angela, wait until you hear what she says.
sentences.zh: 安吉拉，等着听听她怎么说。

sentences.en: I don't remember a ton of details about my time on set, except for that you guys were on your last day of like a very, very, very long cycle of shooting.
sentences.zh: 我不记得在片场时的太多细节了，只记得当时你们正处于一个非常、非常、非常漫长的拍摄周期的最后一天。

sentences.en: And everyone was just dead, tired, and just ready for a hiatus.
sentences.zh: 每个人都累得半死，只想赶紧放假。

sentences.en: So that is what I remember.
But just like the talk was all about how this hiatus was just so needed.
sentences.zh: 只是大家都在谈论这次假期是多么迫切需要。
所以我记得的就是这些。

sentences.en: That and that you guys moved so quickly.
sentences.zh: 还有就是你们的动作非常快。

sentences.en: I don't even know if I got lunch that day.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不知道那天我有没有吃午饭。

sentences.en: And I'm pretty sure you guys banged me out.
sentences.zh: 我敢肯定你们很快就把我打发走了。

sentences.en: And I didn't even get a free lunch.
sentences.zh: 我连顿免费午餐都没混上。

sentences.en: This was, remember early on, we had to do 18 episodes in a row so that we could create that hiatus for Steve to go do a movie?
sentences.zh: 还记得早期吗？我们不得不连续拍摄18集，这样才能给史蒂夫腾出假期去拍电影？

sentences.en: And you guys, you know when you have that stretch of work where you leave work and it's dark out and then you come back to work and it's still dark out?
sentences.zh: 你们知道那种感觉吗，就是当你有一段工作期，下班时天已经黑了，第二天来上班时天还是黑的？

sentences.en: And you're just like, and you sort of all look at each other and joke and be like, see you in a few hours.
sentences.zh: 大家看着彼此开玩笑说，几个小时后再见。

sentences.en: And it's a lot of people who work in the service industry or in the food industry where you have to close the restaurant and then like a few hours later you have to open it.
sentences.zh: 很多在服务业或餐饮业工作的人都会这样，你得负责关店，然后几个小时后又得回来开店。

sentences.en: Well, we were in the clopening phase.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们当时就处于“关开”阶段。

sentences.en: That is hilarious to me because I do remember like when we would wrap after a big stretch like that, I would get like a cold.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说太搞笑了，因为我确实记得，每当经历那样一段高强度工作后杀青，我就会感冒。

sentences.en: Right now we were about to all get sick.
sentences.zh: 当时我们都快要病倒了。

sentences.zh: 这件背心是我和约翰·卡拉辛斯基一起参加媒体活动时穿的那件。

sentences.en: And by the way, it was not Betsy Johnson.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，那不是贝齐·约翰逊的牌子。

sentences.zh: 显然梅雷迪斯很喜欢它，所以又穿上了。

sentences.en: They were really, I think, rubbing it in my face.
sentences.zh: 我觉得她们真的是在故意气我。

sentences.en: Well, there's something happening now that I, as an actor, am super jealous of.
sentences.zh: 好吧，现在发生了一件事，作为演员的我超级嫉妒。

sentences.zh: 因为吉姆和帕姆要去跟鲍勃和菲利斯吃午饭了。

sentences.zh: 珍娜，我真希望能在那儿。

sentences.en: We're the two St. Louis gals.
sentences.zh: 我们俩都是圣路易斯来的姑娘。

sentences.en: And we got to have this whole day of shooting together.
sentences.zh: 我们能一起拍一整天的戏。

sentences.zh: 我们收到了乔·S的一位粉丝提问。

sentences.en: Where were the restaurant scenes for the double date filmed?
sentences.zh: 双重约会的餐厅戏是在哪里拍的？

sentences.zh: 是在一家叫Barsak Brasier的真实餐厅拍的。

sentences.en: It was on Lancashire Boulevard in North Hollywood.
sentences.zh: 它位于北好莱坞的兰开夏大道上。

sentences.zh: 我们找了些群众演员填满餐厅，让他们假装成服务员和食客。

sentences.en: We had the restaurant for half a day.
sentences.zh: 我们包下了那家餐厅半天。

sentences.en: It is no longer in business, but that's where we were.
sentences.zh: 它现在已经倒闭了，但那就是我们当时拍摄的地方。

sentences.en: And we ate their real food.
sentences.zh: 而且我们还吃了他们真正的食物。

sentences.zh: 如果你仔细看桌子，会发现每张桌子上都有吉姆送给帕姆的那束花。

sentences.zh: 然后他们就借口去洗手间了。

sentences.zh: 我觉得在进入迈克尔的“孤独之心”派对之前，我们应该先休息一下。

sentences.en: I mean, at first we're like, is he attracted to her?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，起初我们以为，他是被她吸引了吗？

sentences.en: No, he's just trying to make a huge paper sale.
sentences.zh: 不，他只是想做成一笔巨大的纸张订单。

sentences.en: Jenna, there was a lot in Deleted Scenes of like people just sort of chit-chatting,
sentences.zh: 珍娜，在删减片段里有很多人们闲聊的场景，

sentences.en: trying to flirt, trying to meet people, make conversation.
sentences.zh: 试图调情，试图结识他人，找话题聊天。

sentences.en: He tries to strike up conversation with her.
First of all, he leads off with like, how old are you?
sentences.zh: 首先，他一开口就是问人家多大。

sentences.en: And then he goes from 30 to 60.
sentences.zh: 然后他直接从30岁跳到了60岁。

sentences.en: This is Creed trying to make small talk, guys.
sentences.zh: 伙计们，这就是克里德试图闲聊的样子。

sentences.en: I remember I was in a bar once and a guy tried to flirt with me by asking me how much I weighed.
sentences.zh: 我记得有一次在酒吧，有个男人试图跟我调情，问我体重多少。

sentences.en: And then he said, I bet I can guess.
sentences.zh: 然后他说，我敢打赌我能猜出来。

sentences.en: And then he picked me up without my consent and then said a number.
sentences.zh: 接着他没经过我同意就把我抱了起来，然后报了一个数字。

sentences.en: Fellas, there's so much wrong with this.
sentences.zh: 伙计们，这事儿槽点太多了。

sentences.en: I hope we don't have to break it down for you.
sentences.zh: 我希望我们不需要给你们一一拆解。

sentences.en: Don't say as your pickup line, let me guess your age or your weight.
sentences.zh: 别把“让我猜猜你的年龄或体重”当作搭讪语。

sentences.en: Don't put your hands on a lady unless she invites you to.
sentences.zh: 除非女士邀请你，否则别对她动手动脚。

sentences.en: But you know who did spark some interest in Lynn ultimately was Kevin.
sentences.zh: 但你知道最终确实引起琳恩兴趣的人是凯文。

sentences.en: And he's very charming in his just nervousness and honesty.
sentences.zh: 他那种紧张和诚实的样子非常有魅力。

sentences.en: And doesn't Brian kill it in the scene where he shows that she gave him her business card?
sentences.zh: 还有布莱恩在展示她给他的名片的那场戏里，表现得不是超棒吗？

sentences.en: It reminds me of that episode when they won their parking lot back from the five families.
sentences.zh: 这让我想起他们从五大家族手里赢回停车场的那集。

sentences.en: And he's like, sometimes you just need things to go your way.
sentences.zh: 他说，有时候你就是需要事情按你的意愿发展。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm getting goosebumps just thinking about it when he does that.
sentences.zh: 我是说，一想到他做那个动作，我就起鸡皮疙瘩。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, it looks like they're going to have to close down the party and Glove Girl never shows up.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，看起来他们不得不结束派对，而手套女孩始终没出现。

sentences.en: He wants to keep waiting it out.
And people stick around for a while.
sentences.zh: 大家也留下来陪了一会儿。

sentences.en: And Oscar's ultimately like, no, come on, Michael.
sentences.zh: 最后奥斯卡说，不行，走吧，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Aiden M wrote in to say,
Why did Michael never get to find the lady who left her glove in the blood drive van?
sentences.zh: 为什么迈克尔一直没能找到那个在献血车里留下手套的女士？

sentences.en: Even though he ends up with Holly.
sentences.zh: 尽管他最后和霍莉在一起了。

sentences.en: And Diana P went on to say,

sentences.zh: 为什么这条故事线没有继续下去？

sentences.en: I asked Katie about it because I was curious.
sentences.zh: 我问了凯蒂，因为我也很好奇。

sentences.en: It just shows you how good of a job they did together in that scene that people wanted to see more of the blood drive girl and Michael.
sentences.zh: 这恰恰说明他们在那个场景里配合得有多好，以至于观众都想看到更多关于献血女孩和迈克尔的故事。

sentences.en: Well, the message boards after this episode aired were all for Glove Girl.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这一集播出后的留言板上全是在支持手套女孩的。

sentences.en: And here's what Katie had to say.
So here is the thing about my experience is that when I auditioned, it was with the caveat that it was a possible recurring character.
sentences.zh: 关于我的经历是这样的，我试镜的时候，前提就是这可能是一个常驻角色。

sentences.en: And so all I wanted was to perform well and to impress and to be asked back.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时只想表现出色，给人留下深刻印象，并能被再次邀请回来。

sentences.en: And I'm sure they had their creative reasons.
sentences.zh: 而且我肯定他们有他们的创作考量。

sentences.en: But, oh, boy, I wanted nothing more.
sentences.zh: 但是，天哪，我当时真的特别希望它发生。

sentences.en: But I'm happy with the time I got.
sentences.zh: 不过我对我们拥有的那段时光感到满意。

sentences.en: So I will tell you, story-wise, why Glove Girl did not come back.
sentences.zh: 所以我要告诉你们，从剧情角度来看，为什么“手套女孩”没有回归。

sentences.en: It was not because we were not completely charmed by Katie and her performance.
sentences.zh: 并不是因为我们没有被凯蒂和她的表演完全迷住。
迈克尔有一个单人采访镜头。

sentences.en: And it's really written in this talking head.
sentences.zh: 而且这个采访镜头里写得很清楚。

sentences.en: He says that this is the first time since Holly that he's even considered getting back into the dating marina.
sentences.zh: 他说这是自霍莉之后，他第一次考虑重返约会码头。
就像丘比特的麻雀一样。

sentences.en: And that was the story point of this episode, was not to introduce a new love interest for Michael.
sentences.zh: 这一集的剧情重点并不是要为迈克尔引入一个新的恋爱对象。

sentences.en: They were toying with this idea.
sentences.zh: 他们曾考虑过这个想法。

sentences.en: But really, it was just for Michael to feel like he could connect with someone again.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，这只是为了让迈克尔觉得他可以再次与人建立联系。

sentences.en: But ultimately, they're going to keep him on this trajectory toward Holly.
sentences.zh: 但最终，他们还是打算让他保持通往霍莉的那条轨迹。

sentences.en: But because of this storyline, he's not going to be kind of as broken when he does finally reunite with her.
sentences.zh: 但因为这条故事线，当他最终与她重逢时，他不会显得那么破碎。

sentences.en: He's getting a little bit of his confidence back.
Well, the whole gang is going to leave the building.
sentences.zh: 好吧，整群人都要离开大楼了。

sentences.en: And Jenna, I just want you guys to know, when you watch us all exit, Mindy and I are just having a conversation.
sentences.zh: 还有珍娜，我只是想让你们知道，当你们看着我们所有人离开时，明迪和我在聊天。

sentences.en: I don't know what we're talking about.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我们在聊什么。

sentences.en: And then I feel like they sort of let us know that we were on camera because then I'd go back to Angela Martin.
sentences.zh: 然后我觉得他们好像提醒了我们正在拍摄，因为之后我就变回了安吉拉·马丁。

sentences.en: And I do these little awkward waves goodbye.
sentences.zh: 我还做了那些尴尬的小挥手告别。

sentences.en: But everyone is very pleasant and nice to one another.
sentences.zh: 但每个人对彼此都非常愉快和友善。

sentences.en: Michael's Lonely Hearts party was kind of a success.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔的“孤独之心”派对算是一种成功。

sentences.en: I mean, they were all sort of lonely together.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们都在一起孤独着。

sentences.en: This episode ends with a great tag.
sentences.zh: 这一集以一个很棒的尾声结束。

sentences.en: Stanley goes into the blood mobile, and he's got a little bandage on his arm.
sentences.zh: 斯坦利走进献血车，他的手臂上贴着一个小绷带。

sentences.en: He's got a cotton ball with a little bit of medical tape.
sentences.zh: 他用医用胶带贴着一个棉球。

sentences.en: And he says, I'm so sorry, I gave blood earlier, and I'm still feeling a little woozy.
sentences.zh: 他说，真抱歉，我刚才献了血，现在还有点晕。

sentences.en: Can I have one of those cookies?
And she says, you know what?
You have a cotton ball and medical tape, but we're using Band-Aids.
sentences.zh: 你用的是棉球和医用胶带，但我们用的是创可贴。

sentences.en: And behind him, Phyllis walks up.
sentences.zh: 在他身后，菲利斯走了过来。

sentences.en: He's making a quick exit, and he just goes, Band-Aid.
sentences.zh: 他正准备溜走，随口说了句，创可贴。

sentences.en: And then Creed leaves the truck with his blood in a bag, or someone else's.
sentences.zh: 然后克里德带着一袋血离开了献血车，也不知道是不是他自己的。

sentences.en: I don't know, but this is what Dwight has been worried about the whole episode.
sentences.zh: 我不知道，但这正是德怀特整集都在担心的事。

sentences.en: Well, that was blood drive, everybody.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这就是《献血活动》这一集，各位。

sentences.en: I'm going to put on different shoes.
I encourage you to get a pair of flip-flops.
Yeah, and I guess I have to fix my hair.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我还得去弄弄我的头发。

sentences.en: Well, you do have one guy that's going, he's like at attention.
sentences.zh: 确实有个家伙在那儿，他就像立正了一样。
现在我们要进入秋天了。

sentences.en: Yeah, you got to have your fall hairdo.
sentences.zh: 是啊，你得换个秋季发型。

sentences.en: I'm moving into, I don't know what my fall hairdo is yet, but we're transitioning.
sentences.zh: 我正在换，虽然我还不知道我的秋季发型是什么，但我们正在过渡。
现在正处于留长刘海的阶段。

sentences.en: I can't wait to see what your fall hairdo is.
sentences.zh: 真期待看到你的秋季发型。

sentences.en: Well, I know I'm going to get the truth from you.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我知道你会跟我说实话的。
祝大家度过愉快的一周。
